Name: Astarion of Baldur's Village (Stardew Druid)
Author: neosinf
Description:
===========================================
Stardew Druid: Astarion of Baldur's Village
===========================================

Do you want Astarion of Baldur's Gate 3 and Baldur's Village fame to follow you on real adventures? This is your answer!

This mod doesn't do anything on it's own. Instead it tells Stardew Druid, the main mod, to enable recruitment of the Astarion character in Baldur's Village when using the Recruit Hero effect.

[color=#f6b26b]NOTE: Because the assets for this mod are packaged in Stardew Druid, this extension does not need to be downloaded and installed to be enabled for players who have 'heroic crossovers' set to true in their Stardew Druid configuration file.[/color]

This mod can be enabled and disabled without affecting save files or progression in Stardew Druid.

Check out heroes from other crossover mods here!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32958]Sophia, Blue Moon Avenger
[/url]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32743]Lance of the First Slash[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32565]Sevinae of Alchemistry[/url]﻿

------------------------------------
Future development
------------------------------------

I have advised the Baldur's Village development team (via Nexus) that I am available to add more hero recruits and content at their discretion.

I am happy to receive feedback to improve the aesthetic and behaviour of Astarion in Stardew Druid/

------------------------------------
Astarion looks different
------------------------------------

That's because this is my artistic vision for Astarion based on the press release images for Astarion, and it's also in order to align his sprite animations with the Stardew Druid character model.

------------------------------------
How do I recruit Astarion?
------------------------------------

If you're familiar with Stardew Druid, and you've unlocked the Gift of the Heiress in your playthrough, then you'll know what to do, just cast Rite of Mists: Smite on Astarion when you see him onscreen.

Open the Hero's ledger menu from the Stardew Druid journal screen, and then click on Astarion's entry, then click the check box to summon him.

If you are not interested in a Druid playthrough, you can use the set progress feature in the Stardew Druid configuration to skip right to the Gift of the Heiress unlock, which is progress 30.

Alternatively, the recruit system is immediately available for Magic only mode users of Stardew Druid.
